phases.objective: Bind repository reconciliation control, detached-resolution, and merge-composition steps to engine-owned execution routes so provider dispatch is limited to installed-tool calls while the mutation recipe remains planned and Admin apply remains closed.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A planned repository reconciliation recipe with exact base/head identity, engine control steps, engine-internal detached/merge steps, installed-tool checks, and response projections
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The generated plan hashes execution-route ownership and prior-output bindings, only installed-tool calls are provider-dispatch eligible, lease/evidence controls remain engine-owned, and no apply surface or recipe activation is exposed.
steps: Classify every recipe step into provider-tool, engine-internal, engine-control, engine-evidence, or blocked routing.
Bind the execution route, predecessor, body template, and response projection into each per-step execution contract and plan hash.
Route acquire/release lease and evidence steps internally without provider dispatch or duplicate lease mutation calls.
Route detached resolution construction and merge composition as engine-internal steps that require a separately wired engine executor.
Keep branch reconciliation, CI, and PR lifecycle calls as installed-tool steps only.
Keep the recipe status planned, automatic activation forbidden, force push forbidden, migration apply forbidden, and Admin orchestration apply unexposed.
assertions: classify, engine_internal, and emit_evidence step kinds are never provider-dispatch eligible.
Only installed_tool_call step kinds may use the provider executor.
build_resolution_commit is bound to repositoryDetachedResolutionBuilder and projects resolution.commit_sha without moving a ref.
create_merge_commit consumes the build_resolution_commit result through an explicit plan-bound source step/path contract.
Changing predecessor or response-projection metadata changes plan_sha256.
Lease release remains orchestrator-finally owned rather than a duplicate provider call.
Admin apply remains dry-run-only and repo.pr.reconcile_and_finalize remains planned.
force_push_allowed and migration_apply_allowed remain false and secrets_included remains false.

phases.objective: Wire canonical V6 capability-envelope and approval-hold authority plus plan-bound engine/provider executors and complete positive same-cycle smoke before a separately authorized recipe activation.
